title: Side spend entry (one line of a side ledger)
description: profiles/<slug>/tickets/<id>/side-spend.jsonl, profiles/<slug>/chats/<id>.side-spend.jsonl and the data folder's root helper-spend.jsonl: one compact JSON object per line, appended by addSideSpend (src/runs/side-call.ts) with what a side call (a model call outside the ticket's session) cost. No TypeScript type (the object literal in addSideSpend); read by readSideSpend, which skips lines that don't parse or have no positive costUsd. Only calls that cost something are written. Unknown fields must be kept.

kind.description: Who made the call. Ticket ledger: simplify (src/chat/simplify.ts), help-recap and help-changes (src/chat/explain.ts), learn (src/board/learner.ts), link (src/board/linker.ts), squad (src/huddle/huddle-templates-api.ts). Quick chat ledger: simplify. helper-spend.jsonl: helper (src/helper/runner.ts).
